sources.title: Hcompany/Holotron4-30B-A3B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Holotron4 -30B-A3B is a vision-language model (VLM) for Computer Use, built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni and developed by H Company. Used with the hai-agents harness, it can send screenshots and tool results to the model, then execute its requested clicks, typing, code, and tool calls.

sources.title: Holo4: powering generalist computer-use agents - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A Blog post by H company on Hugging Face Holo4 is our new series of agentic models. It comes in two sizes: 27B dense and 35B-A3B Mixture of Experts. Both are available on the H Models API. We are also releasing an updated version of Holotron 3: Holotron4 Nano. sources.title: H Company Releases Holo4 Open Computer-Use Weights on Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Holotron4 Nano line adds BF16 and FP8 checkpoints (Hcompany/Holotron4-30B-A3B and Hcompany/Holotron4-30B-A3B-FP8) on a NemotronH Nano Omni base for a smaller VRAM footprint on the same computer-use stack.
